propositions: Hand-rolled CLI argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py must be refactored to use stdlib argparse while preserving all observable behavior and command-specific flag semantics.

The --force flag has command-specific parsing: claim bare --force consumes the next non-option token or defaults to '(no reason given)', while transition bare --force sets force_reason='' (not None) and never consumes following tokens.
The --assignee flag must preserve a three-state sentinel: absent maps to None (enabling default_assignee fallback), explicit empty string "" clears the assignee, and explicit values are preserved.
transition._parse_flags must be retained as a shim returning the identical 5-tuple (reason, force_reason, close_class, caused_by, ref) to satisfy three external direct callers in tests.
The argparse parser must silently skip unknown/extra tokens, reject the retired --force-close flag with exit code 1, and reject value-less flags with exit code 1 (not argparse's default exit code 2).
